notes: Performed a full UI consistency pass across Settings and secondary dialogs.
Standardized text fields, combo boxes, spin boxes, time fields, buttons, lists, tables and checkboxes to the same rounded control language and sizing.
Removed the inconsistent full-width checkbox strips and aligned form spacing and label positioning.
Polished Health Check cards so labels no longer inherit card borders and storage rows line up cleanly.
Polished Notification Center cards and added consistent action icons.
Polished About, Saved Searches, Release Comparison, Rename and Download Review dialogs to match the main app.
Added meaningful icons to maintenance, Plex-path and dialog actions where they improve scanning.
